title: UbuntuGuard: A Culturally-Grounded Policy Benchmark for Equitable AI Safety in African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the F1 score performance of LLM guardian models in classifying safe versus unsafe dialogues across an English baseline, cross-lingual settings, and fully localized low-resource African languages.

Evaluating safety policy compliance using a benchmark of adversarial queries, multi-turn dialogues, and dynamic policies grounded in African sociocultural norms, sourced from local domain experts, to highlight gaps in Western-centric models.
